evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 4.0 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the last 28 days, or reverses to below -13%.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility remains severely depressed at -20.1%, signaling continued restrictions on public transport capacity. When TRANSIT falls below -20%, retail footfall cannot recover because commuting infrastructure constrains access to retail districts, suppressing RETAIL_REC growth.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -20.1% in most recent week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -10% over the next four weeks while TRANSIT remains below -20%.

evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose 3.5 points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to baseline when GROCERY_PHARM is above 3.0% and rising.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved 4.3 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises faster than PARKS over the next two weeks, indicating no substitution effect.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES at -9.7% in most recent week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC exceeds -8% over the next four weeks while WORKPLACES remains below -8%.

candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above 11% AND TRANSIT below -20% simultaneously
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -10% when RESIDENTIAL is above 11% and TRANSIT is below -20% for two consecutive weeks.
